stories.headline: Selena Gomez and her mom accused of fraud over their mental health startup - NBC News
stories.summary: Superstar Selena Gomez and her mother are accused of defrauding investors of their mental health startup, Wondermind, in a federal lawsuit filed Thursday.
stories.why: A celebrity mental health advocate being sued for fraud signals how wellness entrepreneurship can mask exploitation—relevant if you follow influencers promoting self-care products or apps you're considering.

stories.headline: ‘The End Of Oak Street’ Stomping To $38M-$48M WW Opening; U.S. Previews At $2M+ – Thursday PM Box Office - Deadline
stories.summary: The J.J. Abrams-produced The End of Oak Street is looking at $2 million-plus in U.S. previews for an estimated global box office opening of $38M-$48M.
stories.why: A $40M+ opening for a J.J. Abrams film shows studios are still betting on high-concept spectacle over established franchises, signaling what studios think will pull you into theaters this year.

stories.headline: Teamsters Pound Paramount Over WBD Merger Promises & Threats: “Stop Playing Games” - Deadline
stories.summary: Hollywood Teamsters called BS on Paramount Over Warner Bros Merger promises & threats
stories.why: The Teamsters calling out Paramount's empty promises exposes how major entertainment mergers affect real jobs and worker leverage—matters if you care about whether studios prioritize talent or shareholders.

stories.headline: Tyler Duckworth, ‘The Challenge’ Reality Show Winner, Dies at 44 - Variety
stories.summary: Tyler Duckworth, who competed on six seasons of reality show "The Challenge" and also appeared on MTV's "The Real World: Key West," has died.
stories.why: A 44-year-old reality TV fixture's death reminds you that the MTV generation you grew up watching is aging into genuine mortality, not just nostalgia.

stories.headline: Jury selected for trial of former gang leader accused of ordering Tupac Shakur’s killing - AP News
stories.summary: A jury has been selected in the trial against the man charged in the 1996 killing of rapper Tupac Shakur. Duane “Keffe D” Davis is the first person to be charged in connection to the drive-by shootin…
stories.why: After 28 years, someone's finally being tried for Tupac's murder—closure on hip-hop's biggest unsolved killing matters culturally because it either validates or upends the narrative you've absorbed since the '90s.

stories.headline: Iowa State Fair announces replacement act for Rod Stewart - WHO13.com

stories.why: Rod Stewart canceling a state fair signals even legacy acts are hitting health walls, a preview of what's coming for the classic rock tours you might still want to catch.

stories.headline: ‘House of the Dragon’ Season 3 Finale Hits 21 Million Viewers in Three Days - Variety
stories.summary: The Season 3 finale of 'House of the Dragon' hit 21 million viewers in three days.
stories.why: House of the Dragon pulling 21M viewers in three days proves HBO still owns prestige fantasy despite recent stumbles—relevant if you're deciding whether to stay subscribed.

stories.headline: Innocent wrestling with sister of wife's best friend reveals cheating with a twist, McDonald's wedding & signs - Fox News
stories.summary: Nicole Kidman says she's embracing love after her divorce from Keith Urban, plus a wild slip 'n slide affair story and a McDonald's wedding in Ohio.
stories.why: Nicole Kidman's post-divorce pivot mixed with tabloid affair stories reflects how celebrity divorce narratives are shifting toward growth messaging rather than scandal—signals what's normalized in celebrity culture now.
